deletion_decision: The original overhaul performed no destructive cleanup. On 2026-09-08 a later positive deletion audit proved the frozen Archive/ and Logs/ payload subtrees byte-identical by Git tree SHA to the verified standalone recovery repository, inventoried every inbound textual reference, established deterministic same-relative-path recovery mapping, and retained current semantic replacements. Those two cold payload trees were therefore externalized from current HEAD while remaining present in primary Git history and the independent recovery repository.
